issues.detail: In TH2, the blueprint requires referencing artifacts A1, T3, and T5, but they are missing from the artifact_refs of all messages in the thread.
The text contains forbidden terms such as 'Performance' (M1), 'score' (M3, M6, M7, M8, M12, M58, M59, M72, M74), and 'scenario' (M38, M44).
Participants frequently use the exact same robotic phrasing to confirm tasks and agreements (e.g., 'Confirmed. I'll...', 'Ready. I'll...'), lacking distinct voices.
